changed.reason: Feeds selected session lifecycle, prompt, cancel, load, resume, set_mode, set_config_option, and tool updates. Session-not-found and invalid-config failures become protocol error codes; the adapter maps every JSON-RPC error to one rejected-request failure class. Publish-current-title and the cancelled-permission denial live behind the v2 agent or outcomes Swallowtail never sends.

classification_rules.mapped_adjacent: A changed artifact file feeds the selected ACP v1 startup, configuration, tool, permission, replay, session, usage, or failure path, but review found its mapped contract compatible with the recorded limits.
classification_rules.provider_internal: A changed artifact file is documentation, an unadvertised capability-gated surface, provider-only helper, or separate ACP v2 path.

source_review_basis: Exact GitHub tags v0.99.0, v0.99.1, and v0.100.0 corresponding to npm gitHead; source inspection was static and limited to selected ACP v1 routes plus capability-gated deltas. Changelog served only as discovery.
